cause_quote: The added `if (gatewayUrlChanged) { everConnected = false; }` sent a retryable transport failure after a Gateway switch through the first-connection path, which displayed sign-in.
user_saw: After switching Gateways, a temporary connection refusal could replace the Control UI with a sign-in form while the browser was still retrying.
summary: The fix keeps the Control UI shell and open drafts available through Gateway startup and automatic retries, and adds a self-retrying page when the app document is unavailable.
reasoning: I checked the parent of #117125 and confirmed that a successful connection kept `everConnected` true across a Gateway switch, so a retryable refusal stayed in `reconnecting` and kept the shell visible. The causing commit added a test expecting sign-in after that same sequence, and this fix reverses that expectation. The fix also changes cold startup and HTTP fallback behavior, which have separate history.
